messages:
Marta (Design): quick sync — proposed change to sidebar IA: move Models under a new 'Workloads' group. Proposed nav (project scope):

/console/{project}/overview
/console/{project}/workloads/models
/console/{project}/workloads/endpoints
/console/{project}/workloads/deployments

Breadcrumbs should read: Project > Workloads > Models > [Model name]. Flagging deep-link/backwards compat concerns. Thoughts?

Eli (Eng): +1 on the grouping for discoverability. Concern: a bunch of external links (emails, docs) still point to /models/:id. We need a redirect strategy.

Sam (PM): Customers will have bookmarks. Can we keep legacy routes and 301 -> canonical? Need to audit docs/SDK references as well.

Harper (DevEx): For compact sidebar we should keep Workloads collapsed by default but auto-expand when a deep link lands. UX: animate expansion to show context.

Rowan (A11y): When auto-expanding, ensure focus stays on main content. Update aria-expanded and provide a skip link. Also add a live region announcement when route changes: "Navigated to Model: <name>".

Marta (Design): Implementation idea: route aliases so both /models/:id and /workloads/models/:id render the same view. Pseudocode:

router:
  /models/:id -> ModelView
  /workloads/models/:id -> ModelView

Eli (Eng): react-router v6 doesn't have alias — we'll add duplicate routes pointing to same component and then canonicalize via history.replace after fetch. Quick spike:

```jsx
<Route path="/models/:id" element={<ModelView />} />
<Route path="/workloads/models/:id" element={<ModelView />} />
// on mount, if path is legacy, do history.replace('/workloads/models/' + id)
```

Sam (PM): Breadcrumbs should reflect canonical path after replace so Project > Workloads > Models > Name is consistent. Also update any shared permalinks to point to canonical.

Rowan (A11y): Also ensure screen-reader announcement fires after replace. Use aria-live="polite" with model name.

Harper (DevEx): Copy note: 'Workloads' might be ambiguous. Alternatives: 'Serving', 'Compute', 'Workloads'. Recommend quick user test on Slack with product folks.

Marta (Design): Action items:
- Eli: spike route alias + canonicalize (today)
- Rowan: draft a11y announce pattern + focus rules
- Harper + Sam: audit docs/bookmarks and recommend redirect strategy
- Marta: update design file with microcopy variants

Goal: canary next week if no major blockers. :calendar:

Eli (Eng): I'll spike this afternoon and ping when branch is ready. Tagging @Deploy Bot when ready for staging.

Deploy Bot: Reminder: create a release branch and run staging tests. Use label "nav-ia-refactor" for tracking.
